description: Validate GDScript syntax or scene integrity using headless Godot. Use before attach_script or run_script to catch parse errors early. Give exactly one of scriptPath, source, or scenePath, or a targets array validated in one Godot process. Returns { valid, errors } for one target, { results: [{ target, valid, errors }] } for a batch. An errors entry is { line?, message } for a parse error, or { check, problem?, message } for a checks[] finding. checks requires scenePath and instantiates the scene, running each attached script's _init(). Any parse error yields valid:false.

checks.description: [single, requires scenePath] Structural and signal-verification checks to run against the scene. Types: "structure" (validate node tree against a schema) and "signals" (verify signal connections and handler methods, optional nodePath scope). Merged into the errors array with a "check" discriminator.

nodePath.description: [signals] Optional node path to scope the check to a subtree (e.g. "root/HUD")

schema.description: [structure] Recursive node schema: { type?: string, children?: Schema[], hasProperty?: string }. Checks the root node and subtree.

type.description: The kind of check to run

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: [single] Path to a .tscn scene file relative to the project to validate (e.g. "scenes/main.tscn")

scriptPath.description: [single] Path to a .gd file relative to the project to validate (e.g. "scripts/player.gd")

source.description: [single] Inline GDScript source code to validate. Written to a temporary file and validated against the project.

targets.description: [batch] Array of targets to validate in a single Godot process. Each item must have exactly one of: scriptPath, source, or scenePath.

checks.description: [requires scenePath] Structural / signal checks for this target, run in the same Godot process as the rest of the batch. Same shape as the top-level checks array.

nodePath.description: [signals] Optional node path to scope the check to a subtree (e.g. "root/HUD")

schema.description: [structure] Recursive node schema: { type?: string, children?: Schema[], hasProperty?: string }. Checks the root node and subtree.

type.description: The kind of check to run

scenePath.description: Path to a .tscn scene file relative to the project

scriptPath.description: Path to a .gd file relative to the project

name: validate
